acmun-2027.about:
ACMUN is Anatolia College's 22nd Model United Nations conference, a THIMUN-affiliated, internationally recognised school MUN on its campus in Thessaloniki.

The conference runs 12–14 February 2027 at the Anatolia College campus, Thessaloniki, Greece. It is open to secondary school students in school delegations (MUN directors register their schools). Working language: English.

School registration opened 1 Sep 2026; early registration ran to 30 Oct and late registration closes 27 Nov 2026. Fees and logistics are set out in the ACMUN Administrative Handbook on the official page. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
highlights: Fees and logistics are set out in the ACMUN Administrative Handbook on the official page
acmun-2027.eligibility: Open to secondary school students in school delegations (MUN directors register their schools). Working language: English. No nationality restrictions are stated; international delegates (including from Georgia and Qatar) can apply, arranging their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open the official website (link below) and read the conference information and committee list.
School registration opened 1 Sep 2026; early registration ran to 30 Oct and late registration closes 27 Nov 2026.
Pay the delegate fee by the stated deadline to confirm your place.
Prepare a position paper using the committee study guides before the conference.
acmun-2027.costs: Fees and logistics are set out in the ACMUN Administrative Handbook on the official page. Travel, accommodation and visas are paid by participants unless stated otherwise.

acmun-xxii-appleby-2027.about:
ACMUN is Appleby College's one-day Model UN, running since 2005 and now in its 22nd year, held from 08:30 to 18:30 on the school's campus near Toronto.

The conference runs 17 April 2027 at Appleby College, Oakville, Canada. It is open to secondary school students and school delegations. Working language: English.

Registration details are published on the official site ('stay tuned for more updates'). The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
highlights: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page
acmun-xxii-appleby-2027.eligibility: Open to secondary school students and school delegations. Working language: English. No nationality restrictions are stated; international delegates (including from Georgia and Qatar) can apply, arranging their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open the official website (link below) and read the conference information and committee list.
Registration details are published on the official site ('stay tuned for more updates').
Pay the delegate fee by the stated deadline to confirm your place.
Prepare a position paper using the committee study guides before the conference.
acmun-xxii-appleby-2027.costs: The delegate fee is published on the official registration page. Travel, accommodation and visas are paid by participants unless stated otherwise.

acsl-2026-27.about:
ACSL organises contests in several divisions by age and ability. Each contest has short-answer questions on computer-science topics (Boolean algebra, graph theory, data structures, bit-string flicking, etc.) and, in upper divisions, a programming problem in Python, C++ or Java.

Schools register teams and administer the contests during set windows; top students are invited to the online ACSL Finals at the end of the year. Schools in Brazil, China, Korea, Myanmar, Thailand and Vietnam register via national partners; everyone else uses the ACSL form.
highlights: Four contests across the school year
acsl-2026-27.eligibility: Students at pre-college schools anywhere in the world, registered by their school/advisor.
how_to_apply: Ask a teacher to register your school on acsl.org
Pick the right division
Sit each contest in your school's window
Qualify for the end-of-year Finals
acsl-2026-27.costs: School registration fee by division (see acsl.org).

afs-argentina-exchange-becas-2027-28.about:
AFS Argentina sends Argentine students on school exchanges of under a month to a full year with host families in North America, Brazil and Costa Rica, Asia (China, Korea, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Thailand, Türkiye), about 20 European countries, and Australia and New Zealand, plus language, summer-school and academic programmes.

AFS Argentina offers school scholarships (Becas Escolares, partial and full, ages 14-18), 18+ scholarships, teacher scholarships and corporate scholarships; it says new calls 'will open very soon'. Book an advisor call or use the candidate portal to apply.
afs-argentina-exchange-becas-2027-28.eligibility: Students in Argentina aged 14-18 (18+ programmes also available).
how_to_apply: Explore programmes on afs.org.ar/programas
Book an advisor call (calendly.com/afsreclutamiento)
Apply through the candidate portal
Watch afs.org.ar/becas for scholarship calls
afs-argentina-exchange-becas-2027-28.costs: Programme fee per destination; partial and full Becas Escolares when calls open.

afs-austria-scholarships-2027-28.about:
AFS Österreich runs school exchanges to about 40 countries in Europe, Latin America, North America, Asia, Oceania and South Africa, from short programmes to a full school year, plus an apprentice exchange. Participants live with a host family and attend a local school.

Need-based AFS scholarships cover up to 70% of programme costs (not Global Choice); families must have gross annual income up to 90,000 euros and pay at least 30%. Selection uses a motivation letter and an interview in Vienna or online; being flexible on country improves your chances. Documents: motivation letter, asset declaration, parents' latest tax return and three months of payslips.

Deadlines: 31 March 2027 for the 2027-28 year programme and winter semester; 30 September for summer-semester departures. The 70th anniversary campaign '70 Jahre 70 Stipendien' adds extra places.
highlights: Up to 70% of costs covered for families up to 90,000 euros income
afs-austria-scholarships-2027-28.eligibility: Students living in Austria aged about 14-18; scholarship requires gross family income up to 90,000 euros per year.
how_to_apply: Choose a programme on afs.at
Use the afs.at application form and state that you want a scholarship
Send motivation letter, asset declaration, tax return and payslips by 31 March 2027
Attend the interview in Vienna or online
afs-austria-scholarships-2027-28.costs: Programme fee per country; scholarship up to 70% (participant pays at least 30%). Global Choice excluded.

afs-bolivia-exchange-2027-28.about:
AFS Programas Interculturales Bolivia sends young people from Bolivia on intercultural school exchanges with volunteer host families and local schools. Destinations include the USA, Brazil, China, the Philippines, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Thailand, Germany, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Czech Republic, Switzerland and Türkiye.

School programmes last 8 months or more for ages 14-18, with language-focused options (German, Chinese, Japanese, English). Apply via the school application form; contact the La Paz office (+591 2 2415000) for dates and support.
highlights: Year or semester with a host family
afs-bolivia-exchange-2027-28.eligibility: Secondary-school students in Bolivia (about 14-18; 18+ programmes where offered).
how_to_apply: Explore programmes on the AFS website
Book an advisory call or pre-register
Submit the application
Selection activities and pre-departure orientation
afs-bolivia-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme fee per destination; AFS scholarships or donor support where available.

afs-brazil-volunteer-germany-2027-s2.about:
AFS Intercultura Brasil runs a Volunteer Work in Germany programme with partial scholarships: participants spend one year in Germany working in social projects while living in the local community. The 17th edition departs in the second semester of 2027 and has 6 places.

Previous editions covered food and accommodation, a minimum allowance of 100 euros per month and health insurance, for ages 18-27; confirm current conditions with AFS Brasil. Applications are open until 25 November 2026.
afs-brazil-volunteer-germany-2027-s2.eligibility: Young people from Brazil, about 18-27 (per previous editions; confirm on afs.org.br).
how_to_apply: Open the bolsas page on afs.org.br
Register for the 17th edition by 25 Nov 2026
Complete AFS selection
afs-brazil-volunteer-germany-2027-s2.costs: Partial scholarship; earlier editions included board and lodging, ~100 euros/month allowance and insurance.

afs-chile-beca-ciudadano-global-2027.about:
AFS Chile sends Chilean secondary students on school exchanges to about 40 countries (Africa, North America, Brazil, Asia, Europe and Oceania). Through its Solidarity Fund it supports more than 50% of school-exchange participants every year.

The Beca Ciudadano Global for 2027 school programmes covers about 90%, 70%, 50% or 30% of the programme price depending on family gross monthly income (up to CLP 1.5 million for 90%, up to 4.5 million for 30%) and grades (6.0+ for 30-50%, 6.5+ for 70-90% in 2023-2025). Selection includes a personal interview, a family interview, a group activity and a Sustainable Development Goals project. The scholarship application is separate from the programme application; contact AFS Chile for the closing date.
highlights: More than half of participants get aid
afs-chile-beca-ciudadano-global-2027.eligibility: Chilean secondary students with average grades of 6.0+ (6.5+ for 70-90%) and family income up to CLP 4.5 million gross per month; age limit of the destination country applies.
how_to_apply: Apply for an AFS school programme at afs.cl/postulacion
Fill in the Beca Ciudadano Global form with income documents
Personal and family interviews and group activity
Present your SDG project
afs-chile-beca-ciudadano-global-2027.costs: Covers about 30-90% of the programme price depending on income band.

afs-colombia-exchange-2027-28.about:
AFS Programas Interculturales Colombia sends young people from Colombia on intercultural school exchanges with volunteer host families and local schools. Destinations include Egypt, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, Brazil, Canada, the USA, South Korea, India, Japan and about 18 European countries.

Programmes run from under a month to 8+ months, plus 18+ programmes. Scholarships are listed at afs.org.co/becas; the Bogotá office (by appointment, +57 302 289 3435) advises on dates.
highlights: Year or semester with a host family
afs-colombia-exchange-2027-28.eligibility: Secondary-school students in Colombia (about 14-18; 18+ programmes where offered).
how_to_apply: Explore programmes on the AFS website
Book an advisory call or pre-register
Submit the application
Selection activities and pre-departure orientation
afs-colombia-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme fee per destination; AFS scholarships or donor support where available.

afs-costa-rica-exchange-2027-28.about:
AFS Programas Interculturales Costa Rica sends young people from Costa Rica on intercultural school exchanges with volunteer host families and local schools. Destinations include Brazil, Canada, the USA, Guatemala, Mexico, China, South Korea, Japan and 15 European countries (Germany, Austria, Belgium, Denmark, Slovakia, Finland, France, Hungary, Italy, Norway, Poland, Czech Republic, Sweden, Switzerland).

Students live with a volunteer host family and attend a local school. Contact AFS Costa Rica (+506 2234 0909) for 2027-28 dates and any financial aid.
highlights: Year or semester with a host family
afs-costa-rica-exchange-2027-28.eligibility: Secondary-school students in Costa Rica (about 14-18; 18+ programmes where offered).
how_to_apply: Explore programmes on the AFS website
Book an advisory call or pre-register
Submit the application
Selection activities and pre-departure orientation
afs-costa-rica-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme fee per destination; AFS scholarships or donor support where available.

afs-czech-republic-scholarships-2027-28.about:
AFS Czech Republic offers school exchanges of three months, a semester or a full year in more than 99 destinations, with host-family placement.

Scholarships include: Czech-German Future Fund (25,000-60,000 CZK for Germany), the Honorary Consulate in Stuttgart grant (75,000 CZK, Baden-Württemberg), the Škoda Auto Foundation (90% of the fee up to 250,000 CZK for students from Mladá Boleslav, Rychnov, Vrchlabí and Jilemnice areas), AAI scholarships for Türkiye, Hong Kong, Indonesia and China (40,800-98,400 CZK), 'Destination Unknown' (50% off semester programmes), host-family and volunteer discounts, plus the Jaroslava Moserová collection.
highlights: Up to 90% covered by the Škoda Auto fund
afs-czech-republic-scholarships-2027-28.eligibility: Secondary-school students living in the Czech Republic; each fund has its own criteria (region, destination, need).
how_to_apply: Find a programme on afs.cz
Submit the AFS application form
Apply for the matching scholarship by its deadline
Attend selection
afs-czech-republic-scholarships-2027-28.costs: Programme fee per destination; scholarships 25,000-250,000 CZK or 50-90% of the fee.

afs-denmark-scholarship-summer-2027.about:
AFS Interkultur Danmark sends Danish young people (14-18+) to more than 60 countries on summer (4-5 weeks), trimester, semester and full-year programmes with host families.

The AFS Interkultur exchange scholarship (or the AFS Alumni DK scholarship - you may hold only one) supports school-programme participants who need financial help, based on household economy, social situation and motivation. It can be up to the normal participant fee but cannot be used for English-speaking destinations. Deadline for summer 2027 departures: 1 February 2027. Greenlandic students can also use NunaFonden and Sullissivik grants listed on the same page.
highlights: Need-based, up to the full participant fee
afs-denmark-scholarship-summer-2027.eligibility: Students in Denmark (and Greenland) joining an AFS school programme to a non-English-speaking country who need financial help.
how_to_apply: Choose a non-English-speaking AFS destination
Apply for the programme on afs.dk
Submit the scholarship application by 1 Feb 2027
Provide household and motivation information
afs-denmark-scholarship-summer-2027.costs: Programme fee; scholarship up to the full participant fee.

afs-dominican-republic-exchange-2027-28.about:
AFS Programas Interculturales República Dominicana sends young people from Dominican Republic on intercultural school exchanges with volunteer host families and local schools. Destinations include Brazil, China, Japan, Germany, Austria, Belgium, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Hungary, Italy, Norway, Poland, Slovakia, Switzerland, Türkiye, the UK, Canada and the USA.

Programmes last 3 to 10 months (school year, cultural exchange year, university and short programmes) for ages 14-18+. Contact the Santo Domingo office (+1 809 338 8383) for dates and scholarships.
highlights: Year or semester with a host family
afs-dominican-republic-exchange-2027-28.eligibility: Secondary-school students in Dominican Republic (about 14-18; 18+ programmes where offered).
how_to_apply: Explore programmes on the AFS website
Book an advisory call or pre-register
Submit the application
Selection activities and pre-departure orientation
afs-dominican-republic-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme fee per destination; AFS scholarships or donor support where available.

afs-finland-exchange-2027.about:
AFS Finland offers host-family school exchanges in Asia (Philippines, Hong Kong, India, Japan, China, South Korea, Malaysia, Thailand), about 25 European countries, about 10 Latin American countries, Australia and New Zealand, Canada and the USA, plus Global Choice, gap-year and virtual programmes.

Durations are 3-4, 4-6 or 8-11 months with spring or autumn departures, for ages 14-18+. Flights and insurance are included in the programme price. Applications for 2027 are open now and accepted year-round; places are filled in order, so popular destinations close early.
afs-finland-exchange-2027.eligibility: Young people living in Finland, about 14-18+ (varies by destination).
how_to_apply: Choose a destination on afs.fi
Apply at application.afs.org/finland
Interview/orientation with AFS Finland
Confirm place and pay the programme fee
afs-finland-exchange-2027.costs: Programme price per destination (includes flights and insurance).

afs-france-scholarships-summer-2027.about:
AFS Vivre Sans Frontière sends French students on school programmes with host families abroad (e.g. Ireland, Argentina, Hungary, Thailand and many more). Its solidarity fund awards need-based scholarships calculated from the programme fee, household reference taxable income and number of dependants; past awards include 7,200 euros (Japan), 3,500 euros (Denmark) and 2,400 euros (India). Aid can be increased for AFS volunteering or hosting.

For summer 2027 departures, the complete file must arrive by 1 February 2027 if you registered before 15 January 2027, otherwise by 1 March 2027; decisions on 20 April 2027. Not eligible: Canada (Québec and Global Choice), New Zealand, Ireland and the Danish folk-college programme.
highlights: Means-tested scholarships up to several thousand euros
afs-france-scholarships-summer-2027.eligibility: Students in France registered on an AFS school programme whose estimated aid (online calculator) is above zero; some destinations excluded.
how_to_apply: Check your estimated aid with the online calculator
Register online for an eligible programme (before 15 Jan 2027 for the early deadline)
Tick 'aide au financement' in your online file and submit it
Committee decision by 20 April 2027
afs-france-scholarships-summer-2027.costs: Programme fee; scholarship amount depends on income and dependants (examples 2,400-7,200 euros); preferential bank loan available.

afs-germany-school-exchange-scholarships.about:
AFS Interkulturelle Begegnungen is one of Germany's largest non-profit school-exchange organisations. Students live with a volunteer host family and attend a local school in one of 53 countries across Africa, Asia, Europe, Latin America, North America and Oceania, for a few months up to a full school year.

More than 30% of AFS participants get a scholarship, usually partial (500-8,000 euros, at most 75% of the price). There are motivation scholarships, income-based scholarships (better chances below about 15,000 euros net household income per person), and named funds: Jürgen-Blankenburg, Helga-von-Hoffmann (Latin America), Asia Kakehashi+ (Japan), MercatorGO! (Türkiye), Czech Republic, volunteering, sports, Regenbogen (LGBTQIA+), non-Gymnasium schools and employer scholarships. Auslands-BAföG can also be used.

Apply for the programme first; after the contract confirmation you apply for a scholarship. If the scholarship is refused or too small you may withdraw free of charge within 14 days.
highlights: Over 30% of participants receive 500-8,000 euro scholarships
Free withdrawal if your scholarship is too low
afs-germany-school-exchange-scholarships.eligibility: School students living in Germany, roughly 15-18 at departure (exact age by country). Scholarships: motivation-based or income-based; some reserved for specific countries, schools or groups.
how_to_apply: Choose a country and programme on afs.de
Submit the AFS online application
After the contract confirmation, apply for a scholarship
Interview/selection weekend with AFS volunteers
Decide within 14 days of the scholarship decision
afs-germany-school-exchange-scholarships.costs: Programme price per country (AFS price list); 10% due at contract signing. Scholarships 500-8,000 euros, max. 75% of costs; Auslands-BAföG possible.

afs-guatemala-exchange-2027-28.about:
AFS Programas Interculturales Guatemala sends young people from Guatemala on intercultural school exchanges with volunteer host families and local schools. Destinations include Canada, the USA, Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Mexico, Panama, the Dominican Republic, China, the Philippines, Japan and many European countries (featured: Germany, Italy, the USA, the UK).

AFS Guatemala works with financial, community and individual donors to partially fund some programmes (not all). Pre-register online and contact the Guatemala City office for dates.
highlights: Year or semester with a host family
afs-guatemala-exchange-2027-28.eligibility: Secondary-school students in Guatemala (about 14-18; 18+ programmes where offered).
how_to_apply: Explore programmes on the AFS website
Book an advisory call or pre-register
Submit the application
Selection activities and pre-departure orientation
afs-guatemala-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme fee per destination; AFS scholarships or donor support where available.

afs-hong-kong-summer-exchange-2027.about:
AFS Hong Kong's Summer Exchange Programme gives Hong Kong students aged 14-18 two to four weeks abroad studying a theme at a local school, staying in a school dormitory or with a host family. Recent summer exchanges have included Czechia (GCE Project).

Scholarships and funding are listed on afs.hk/scholarship. Contact AFS Hong Kong (2802 0383) for the summer 2027 destinations and deadlines.
how_to_apply: Read the summer programme page afs.hk/sp
Submit the online form
Check afs.hk/scholarship
Pre-departure orientation
afs-hong-kong-summer-exchange-2027.costs: Programme fee; scholarships and funding listed on afs.hk.

afs-hong-kong-year-exchange-2027-28.about:
AFS Hong Kong's Year Exchange Programme lets Hong Kong secondary students spend 9-10 months in a fully foreign-language environment: they live with a volunteer host family and attend a local high school. The age limit has been raised from 18.5 to 20, so recent school leavers can also apply.

The 2027-28 application deadline is 2 January 2027; those who registered early were interviewed on 14 November 2026. AFS also runs 2-4-week summer exchanges for ages 14-18, and lists scholarships and funding on afs.hk/scholarship.
highlights: Year at a foreign high school with a host family
how_to_apply: Read programme details on afs.hk/yp
Submit the form at afs.hk/study-abroad/form by 2 Jan 2027
Attend the selection interview
Apply for AFS HK scholarships if needed
afs-hong-kong-year-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme fee; scholarships and funding listed on afs.hk/scholarship.

afs-hungary-exchange-autumn-2027.about:
AFS Magyarország offers school exchanges of 3-11 months in more than 45 countries (highlighted: USA, Japan, Italy, Brazil, Spain, Thailand) with host-family placement and attendance at a local school. Autumn 2027 departures start in August or September.

Prices start around 5,700 euros including airfare, insurance, full board and 24/7 support (visa and pocket money extra). Applications are rolling and seats fill in order. Only partial scholarships exist: you pay the first 20%, then submit the scholarship form by the date given in your selection email; a separate AAI scholarship supports some Asian programmes.
highlights: Partial scholarships and AAI Asia scholarship
afs-hungary-exchange-autumn-2027.eligibility: Secondary-school students living in Hungary (age limits by destination).
how_to_apply: Attend an AFS info evening (afs.hu/afs-infoest)
Apply at afs.hu/jelentkezes
Pass selection
Submit the scholarship form by the deadline in your selection email
afs-hungary-exchange-autumn-2027.costs: From about 5,700 euros (flights, insurance, board, support); partial scholarships limited.

afs-iceland-exchange-2027-28.about:
AFS Iceland sends Icelandic students on exchanges of 1 week to 12 months in about 50 countries in Africa (Egypt, Ghana, South Africa), Asia (including Mongolia, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea), Europe, New Zealand, North America and Latin America, plus summer schools, language courses and 18+ programmes.

Students live with a host family and attend a local school. Applications go through afs.is/saekja-um and study grants (námsstyrkir) are listed at afs.is/namsstyrkir.
highlights: About 50 destinations incl. Mongolia and Ghana
how_to_apply: Choose a destination on afs.is
Apply via afs.is/saekja-um
Check námsstyrkir for grants
Interview and orientation
afs-iceland-exchange-2027-28.costs: Programme fee; study grants listed on afs.is/namsstyrkir.

afs-japan-year-program-2027-additional.about:
AFS Japan's Year Programme sends Japanese high-school students to live with a host family and attend a local school for one school year in about 40 countries; AFS assigns the region, school and host family. The 74th term departs in 2027, and AFS is running an additional selection to fill remaining places.

Selection is an individual online interview from home on 5 November, 15 November or 3 December 2026; applicants to the U.S. also sit the ELTiS English test. Applications close at noon on 30 October, 4 November and 25 November respectively, but places are given first-come, first-served and each country closes when full. You need an Eiken (英検) certificate and a school recommendation; successful candidates must attend a residential orientation on 26-28 December 2026.

About 100 scholarship places from various sponsors are attached to the Year Programme, with scholarship results sent about two weeks after the exam.
highlights: Year at a local high school with a host family in ~40 countries
Online interview; last window closes 25 Nov 2026
afs-japan-year-program-2027-additional.eligibility: High-school students in Japan who meet the age window shown by the birth-date self-check in the online entry form. English proficiency certificate (Eiken) and school recommendation letter required.
how_to_apply: Do the birth-date self-check on afs.or.jp to see which countries you can apply for
Submit the online entry by noon on the window's closing date (last: 25 Nov 2026)
Upload your Eiken certificate and school recommendation
Take the online interview (and ELTiS for the U.S.)
Attend the 26-28 Dec 2026 orientation if selected; apply for scholarships per the scholarship list
afs-japan-year-program-2027-additional.costs: Programme fee payable (see AFS Japan programme guide); about 100 scholarship places from sponsors reduce or cover costs.

afs-latvia-exchange-2027-28.about:
AFS Latvia offers Latvian students aged 14-18 school exchanges of 3-4 months, 4-8 months or 8+ months and summer programmes with host families in about 30 countries: 16 in Europe, Canada and the USA, Argentina/Uruguay, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, Mexico, Australia, China, Hong Kong, Japan, Thailand and South Africa.

Applications are handled by the Riga office; contact AFS Latvia for 2027-28 departure dates and any scholarships.
how_to_apply: Browse destinations on afs.lv/study-abroad
Contact AFS Latvia (Blaumaņa iela 38/40, Rīga, +371 67280646)
Submit the application
Selection and orientation

afs-mexico-exchange-becas-2027-28.about:
AFS Intercultura México sends Mexican students on high-school exchanges (1 month to a full year) to Europe, Asia (China, Hong Kong, India, Japan, Thailand), Brazil, Egypt, Canada and the USA, and offers language courses, volunteering, academic, internship and vocational programmes for 18+.

AFS Mexico offers full or partial scholarships through partner alliances (details on its 'becas en el extranjero' page) and lists external financing options. Applications are taken on a rolling basis via afs.org.mx/aplica-hoy; offices in Mexico City and Mérida advise families.
highlights: Destinations in Europe, Asia, Brazil, Egypt and North America
Full or partial becas via partners
afs-mexico-exchange-becas-2027-28.eligibility: Students in Mexico aged about 14-18 (18+ programmes also available).
how_to_apply: Explore programmes on afs.org.mx/preparatoria
Apply at afs.org.mx/aplica-hoy
Ask about becas (afs.org.mx/acerca_de_afs/becas_en_el_extranjero)
Selection and orientation
afs-mexico-exchange-becas-2027-28.costs: Programme fee per destination; full or partial scholarships via partner alliances.

afs-new-zealand-scholarships-round-2-202.about:
AFS New Zealand sends students on school exchanges, graduate programmes (3-11 months for Year 13 students and school leavers) and community-service programmes in Brazil and Costa Rica.

Scholarships: Empowerment - Whakamanaia (NZ$500-9,000; Māori, Pasifika, refugee-background or disadvantaged students), Spirit of AFS / Diversity (listed countries such as Ghana, Kenya, Mexico, Thailand), Excellence Awards, Asian Heritage grants, alumni-funded awards (Michael Jull, Ross Mathieson, South Auckland Counties, Thames Valley up to NZ$5,000) and family discounts.

You must have an accepted AFS programme application before applying. Rounds: 1 Feb - 31 Mar 2027 (decisions in May) and 1 Jul - 31 Aug 2027 (decisions in October).
highlights: Dedicated awards for Māori, Pasifika and refugee-background students
afs-new-zealand-scholarships-round-2-202.eligibility: Students in New Zealand with an accepted AFS programme application; each award has its own criteria (need, heritage, excellence, region).
how_to_apply: Submit and get accepted on an AFS NZ programme
Choose the scholarships that fit you
Apply in Round 2 (1 Feb - 31 Mar 2027) with evidence (letters, certificates, video)
Receive decision in the second week of May
afs-new-zealand-scholarships-round-2-202.costs: Programme fee per destination; grants NZ$500-9,000.

afs-norway-exchange-year-2027-28.about:
AFS Norge offers a 10-month school year abroad with host-family placement in Africa, Asia, Europe, Latin America, North America and Oceania (autumn or winter departure), and 4-7-week language trips, for ages 14-18.

Because AFS is approved by Lånekassen (the Norwegian State Educational Loan Fund), exchange students can receive a grant of NOK 50,000-70,000 depending on destination (travel and living support, plus a means-tested basic grant), if the year is approved as VG2 with their school. AFS also has its own scholarship fund.

Applications are rolling via afs.no/soknad; the Lånekassen form opens in May of the year you travel.
afs-norway-exchange-year-2027-28.eligibility: Students living in Norway aged about 14-18; Lånekassen support requires the year to be approved as VG2 with your school.
how_to_apply: Pick a destination and departure on afs.no
Apply via afs.no/soknad
Agree VG2 approval with your school
Apply to Lånekassen when the form opens in May 2027
Ask AFS about its scholarship fund
afs-norway-exchange-year-2027-28.costs: Programme fee per destination; Lånekassen grant NOK 50,000-70,000 plus possible AFS scholarship.

afs-panama-exchange-2027-28.about:
AFS Programas Interculturales Panamá sends young people from Panama on intercultural school exchanges with volunteer host families and local schools. Destinations include Canada, the USA, Brazil, the Philippines, Japan, Germany, Austria, France, Italy, the UK and Switzerland.

Options include high school abroad (1 to 11 months), English courses, internships and university programmes for ages 14-18+. Contact AFS Panamá (Credicorp Bank Tower, Calle 50) for dates and scholarships.
highlights: Year or semester with a host family
afs-panama-exchange-2027-28.eligibility: Secondary-school students in Panama (about 14-18; 18+ programmes where offered).

afs-paraguay-beca-completa-2027-28.about:
AFS Paraguay's open scholarships fund a full school year abroad for Paraguayan students with limited means: the Beca Completa Abierta covers 100% of the annual school programme and the Media Beca Abierta 50% (destination by availability; flights, visa, documents, school supplies and pocket money not covered). Recipients commit to volunteer with AFS in Paraguay for two years after returning.

In the 2026-27 cycle the call launched on 22 December 2025, opened on 5 January and closed on 30 January 2026, with an in-person evaluation day, family interviews and results on 23 February. Requirements were: 9th grade or 1st/2nd year of Media, average grade 5 in the last three years, financial need, leadership or community service, and a birth date window. The 2027-28 call is expected on the same schedule (launch late December 2026, deadline late January 2027).
highlights: 100% or 50% of a school year abroad
For talented students with limited means
afs-paraguay-beca-completa-2027-28.eligibility: Students in 9th grade, 1st or 2nd year of Media in Paraguay with top grades (5), limited financial means and openness to any destination; birth-date window set in each call.
how_to_apply: Watch AFS Paraguay's social media for the late-December launch
Join the January webinar
Submit the four forms (general, social project, health, socio-economic) by the late-January deadline
Attend the evaluation day and family interview
afs-paraguay-beca-completa-2027-28.costs: Full scholarship: 100% of the annual programme (half scholarship: 50%). Not covered: flights, visa, documents, supplies, monthly extras.

School-year exchanges are for ages 15-17: register and book a call with an AFS advisor, pay the registration fee, complete the online application with three preferred destinations, then take part in selection activities. AFS Perú works with donors to fund full and partial scholarships (Beca Ciudadano Global).

AFS Philippines lists scholarships on its website (afs.ph/scholarships); contact the office (+63 2 8660-6500) for the 2027-28 schedule and scholarship calls.

afs-south-africa-study-abroad-2027.about:
AFS Interculture South Africa sends South African young people on High School Abroad, language, volunteer, gap-year, internship and teacher-exchange programmes, from under a month to more than 8 months, in Egypt, Asia (China, India, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand), Europe (France, Italy, Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Germany), Latin America and the USA.

AFS SA offers full and partial scholarships funded by corporate and community sponsors and donors. The current scholarships have been fully allocated; new opportunities are announced on its website and social media.

afs-sweden-exchange-2027-28.about:
AFS Sweden offers Swedish students aged 15-18 a school year, semester, trimester or short summer programme abroad with a host family, plus 18+ programmes, in about 20+ countries across Latin America, Asia, Africa (Ghana), Europe and North America. Costs are roughly SEK 107,000-180,000 depending on destination and length; some EU/Swiss exchange students qualify for CSN study grants.

Places are limited, so AFS recommends applying about a year ahead. Free online information meetings run on 24 November 2026 and 19 January 2027 (18:30-19:30).

Destinations incl. Ghana, Ecuador, Thailand, Hong Kong

afs-switzerland-scholarships-summer-2027.about:
AFS Switzerland sends young people from Switzerland on school exchanges, programmes for apprentices, bridge-year programmes and short programmes to Europe, Latin America, North America, Asia, Africa and Oceania.

The classic AFS scholarship supports families with limited budgets (guideline: taxable income under CHF 80,000 and net assets under CHF 500,000) and covers 25-100% of the programme cost, decided by the Scholarship Committee after an interview. 'Destination Unknown' offers a reduced price regardless of income: you pick a semester or year and learn your country shortly before departure.

Submit the full AFS application with at least three destinations, the scholarship form, a motivation statement and tax documents. Deadline 15 November 2026 for summer 2027 departures (15 June 2027 for winter departures). Recipients report during the stay and volunteer for AFS afterwards.
afs-switzerland-scholarships-summer-2027.eligibility: Young people living in Switzerland, about 14-18+. Classic scholarship: taxable family income under ~CHF 80,000 and net assets under CHF 500,000 (guideline).
how_to_apply: Contact AFS or start the scholarship process online
Submit the AFS application listing at least 3 destinations
Add the scholarship form, motivation and tax documents by 15 Nov 2026
Interview with the Scholarship Committee
afs-switzerland-scholarships-summer-2027.costs: Programme fee per destination; scholarships cover 25-100%.

afs-thailand-year-program-batch-66.about:
AFS Thailand's Year Programme (Batch 66, travel year 2570-2571) places Thai secondary students abroad for about one academic year with a host family or in a boarding school. Students depart between July and September 2027 and return May-July 2028; exact dates depend on the host country.

The AFS Thailand Foundation offers full scholarships for academically strong students with limited means, and the Corporate Scholarship Program funds employees' children by each sponsor's criteria. Round 3 is currently recruiting; apply through the oneafs.org admission portal.
highlights: Year abroad with host family or boarding school
Full foundation scholarships for strong, low-income students
afs-thailand-year-program-batch-66.eligibility: Thai students in M.3, M.4 or M.5 (or equivalent) in academic year 2569.

Sit the AFS selection steps
afs-thailand-year-program-batch-66.costs: Programme fee; full AFS Thailand Foundation scholarships and corporate scholarships available.

afs-uruguay-exchange-2027-28.about:
AFS Programas Interculturales Uruguay sends young people from Uruguay on intercultural school exchanges with volunteer host families and local schools. Destinations include Canada, the USA, Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, China, South Korea, India, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Thailand, about 24 European countries, Australia and New Zealand.

Programmes range from under a month to a full year (school, language, STEM, sports, PEACE programme, summer school). akamun-2027.about:
AKA MUN is the fourth edition of the Akademeia High School Model UN in Warsaw: three days of debate across twelve committees with about 250 delegates.

The conference runs 26–28 February 2027 at Akademeia High School, Warsaw, Poland. It is open to secondary school students from Poland and abroad. Working language: English.

Register via the official site (international delegates have a dedicated page); chair applications closed 1 Nov 2026. Delegate fee: 300 PLN. As at any MUN, delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions — hands-on training in public speaking, research and diplomacy that universities value.
akamun-2027.eligibility: Open to secondary school students from Poland and abroad. Working language: English. No nationality restrictions are stated; international delegates (including from Georgia and Qatar) can apply, arranging their own visa and travel.
how_to_apply: Open the official website (link below) and read the conference information and committee list.
Register via the official site (international delegates have a dedicated page); chair applications closed 1 Nov 2026.
Pay the delegate fee by the stated deadline to confirm your place.
Prepare a position paper using the committee study guides before the conference.
akamun-2027.costs: Delegate fee: 300 PLN. Travel, accommodation and visas are paid by participants unless stated otherwise.

alchemist-accelerator-enterprise.about:
Alchemist Accelerator is a venture-backed accelerator in the San Francisco Bay Area dedicated to startups that sell to enterprises. It runs cohort-based programmes with intensive coaching on enterprise sales and fundraising, a large mentor network and a Demo Day attended by investors.

Alongside its core programme it runs specialised cohorts with partners (for example a deep-tech cohort with a quantum focus launched with the University of Chicago). Founders from outside the US have participated, with much of the programme available remotely.

Applications are rolling via the 'Tell us what you are building' form on the website; Alchemist typically invests a small amount in exchange for equity.
alchemist-accelerator-enterprise.eligibility: Early-stage enterprise (B2B) startups from any country with a technical founding team.
how_to_apply: Read the programme page.
Submit the online application describing what you are building.
Interview with the Alchemist team.
Join the next cohort if accepted.
alchemist-accelerator-enterprise.costs: No fee; Alchemist invests in exchange for equity.

amgen-scholars-asia-iiit-hyderabad-2027.about:
Amgen Scholars is a summer undergraduate research programme funded by the Amgen Foundation. In the Asia programme, each host university places scholars in a lab for about 8–10 weeks of full-time research, with seminars and networking, and all scholars meet at a symposium in Japan in August (travel, room and board for the symposium are covered).

You do not need to study at the host university or be a citizen of an Asian country: you must be enrolled as an undergraduate at a university anywhere in Asia as defined by the UN (Eastern, South-Eastern, Central, Southern and Western Asia, which includes countries such as Georgia, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE). Each host has its own application and its own package for housing, meals and travel, so read the host page carefully.
highlights: Full-time lab research at a leading Asian university
Open to undergraduates at any university in Asia, including Georgia and the Gulf
All-expenses-paid Amgen Scholars symposium in Japan
amgen-scholars-asia-iiit-hyderabad-2027.eligibility: Undergraduates enrolled at a degree-granting university in Asia (UN definition, including Western Asia), who have completed at least their first year, are not graduating before the programme and will return for at least one more term. Strong academic record, English proficiency (e.g. TOEFL iBT 72 / IELTS 5.5 if not a native speaker) and interest in a PhD. Citizenship of an Asian country is not required.
how_to_apply: Check the host university's Amgen Scholars page for its application form (applications open from November)
Prepare your official transcript and personal statement
Ask a professor for a recommendation letter
Submit the separate application for each host you choose by 1 February 2027
Applicants are notified by early April 2027
amgen-scholars-asia-iiit-hyderabad-2027.costs: Housing, meals and travel support vary by host (check the host page); symposium travel, room and board are covered. No tuition.

amgen-scholars-europe-cambridge-2027.about:
Amgen Scholars Europe gives undergraduates a funded summer of hands-on research in a lab at one of five leading European institutions (ETH Zurich, Institut Pasteur, Karolinska Institutet, LMU Munich and the University of Cambridge). Scholars work on a real research project, attend seminars on science and drug discovery, and in early September everyone meets at the Amgen Scholars Europe Symposium at the University of Cambridge (travel, room and board for the symposium are covered).

You do not need to study at the host: you must be enrolled at a university in a country of the European Higher Education Area (Bologna Process), which includes Georgia, Türkiye, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Ukraine and the whole EU. Each host runs its own application and its own support package for housing, meals and travel; you may apply to several hosts.
highlights: Real research project in a top European lab
Open to students at universities in all Bologna Process countries, including Georgia
Symposium at Cambridge with travel, room and board covered
amgen-scholars-europe-cambridge-2027.eligibility: Undergraduates enrolled at a university in a European Higher Education Area (Bologna Process) country, including Georgia, in the second year of a three-year bachelor's or the second/third year of a four-year integrated programme at the time of application. Strong academic record and interest in a PhD. Nationality is not restricted.
how_to_apply: Choose one or more hosts and open each host's Amgen Scholars page (linked from amgenscholars.com/europe-programme)
Prepare an official transcript, a personal statement and a recommendation letter
Submit a separate application to each host by 1 February 2027
Selected scholars are notified in spring and must attend the Cambridge symposium in September
amgen-scholars-europe-cambridge-2027.costs: Housing, meals and travel support for the summer vary by host (see the host's page); the September symposium in Cambridge is fully covered. No tuition.
